ocean: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production ocean environment background for an isometric survival strategy game, landscape 3:2, high resolution. Create a rich semi-realistic game scene seen from a high oblique/isometric camera looking down at a cold deep teal ocean, no horizon. Detailed physically believable rolling small waves, irregular white foam streaks, subsurface jade colors, subtle warm late afternoon sun reflections entering from upper left, atmospheric mist and cinematic depth. In the far upper left edge a few barely visible drowned concrete ruins and a broken navigation buoy establish an apocalypse; sparse driftwood near outer edges only. The center 65% and lower center MUST remain open unobstructed water, since an interactive wooden raft will be drawn over this area by the game engine. Naturalistic painterly 3D game art with realistic water materials, restrained desaturated blue-green palette, amber sunlight, mood of lonely exploration after civilization flooded. High visual detail but quiet contrast under gameplay area. View angle consistent with isometric tiles whose diamond width:height is 2:1. No boat, no raft, no buildings in center, no characters, no UI, no grid, no icons, no lettering, no text, no watermark, no vignette frame. This is actual in-game background artwork, not a poster or mockup.
